description: ReFED's own sectors, food types and destinations, added alongside the New Zealand MfE taxonomy so that a ReFED comparison run uses ReFED's dimensions rather than a mapping onto NZ categories. Every code is prefixed refed_ and nothing here replaces or edits an existing row.
source_header: Calculated by ReFED based on data from various sources. See https://insights.refed.com/methodology for more information. Data last updated April 03 2026
